tasks.prompt: In guava/src (not android/), explain how refreshAfterWrite works in LocalCache: when a read finds an entry that is due for refresh, which LocalCache.Segment methods run, in order, until the new value is stored? List them.
I want to add a new option to CacheBuilderSpec in guava/src (not android/), so that the spec string can set it. Which fields and methods of CacheBuilderSpec do I need to change or extend? List them.

In guava/src (not android/), trace what happens when I call Futures.transform(input, function, executor): which class and methods create the output future, how does it get notified when input completes, and which method applies the function? Name the class and methods.
Which classes in guava/src (main code, not android/, not tests) directly implement the com.google.common.cache.Cache interface, i.e. declare `implements Cache<K, V>` themselves? List them all.

In guava/src/com/google/common/cache/LocalCache.java, how does a cache read record access order for LRU eviction without taking the segment lock? Name the method called on a read, the queue it uses, and the method that later drains that queue.
